value.rationale: Combining the two separate envy-free channels is needed to estimate their union without double counting. Their intersection unexpectedly has position-exchangeable indicators, a constant exact mean and a non-Poisson geometric limiting count with positive probability of zero even as the market grows. This is a structural dependence law not supplied by either marginal or by the known one-sided count distribution.
